nodes.label: ADR-013 Optional Cloud Dialogue Routing
nodes.description: Accepted hybrid routing sends player-facing Tier 1 dialogue to an optional cloud model for quality and speed while keeping simulation and intent local; absent cloud configuration preserves local-only behavior.

nodes.label: Dialogue Quality, Cost, and Offline Tradeoff
nodes.description: Cloud dialogue improves player-facing quality and frees local resources but adds token cost and network dependence; the static local fallback maintains offline play.

edges.description: Cloud dialogue augments rather than replaces the accepted local inference baseline.
Quality and speed gains are balanced against cost and network dependency to motivate category-specific hybrid routing.
